style.name: Colorful Scandinavian
style.definition: Nordic practicality with cheerful, carefully repeated blues, reds and butter yellow.
style.materials: birch; cotton; cobalt lacquer; striped wool; opal glass
style.living: dusty blue tailored birch-leg sofa; butter-yellow birch armchair; cobalt lacquer oval coffee table; birch TV cabinet; round birch table with four red spindle chairs; opal pendant; striped wool rug
style.bed: birch spindle queen; white bedding with blue stripe and yellow throw; birch nightstands; red small table lamps
style.solarium: light teak outdoor seating with blue striped performance cushions; red aluminum dining chairs and teak table
style.implement: Keep colored pieces small and repeat each accent twice for coherence.
style.avoid: Avoid changing every surface to a different saturated color.
